title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Roll, Auto Sell & Auto Pets
features:
Automate your Sell Ores progression with Axon Hub. Roll for ores, filter purchases by rarity, collect crates, process them through your furnace, and sell them automatically. Includes automatic upgrades, pet management, boost usage, and customizable farming settings.

AUTO FARM & SELL
• Auto Collect — teleports to your crate pile, collects it, and returns you to your previous position.
• Collect when your pile reaches a chosen cash value or on a configurable timer.
• Auto Furnace — deposits collected crates into your furnace for processing.
• Auto Sell — sells collected crates, with support for the furnace collection workflow.

AUTO ROLL & ORE COLLECTION
• Auto Spin — automatically rolls at your lever and returns you if you move away.
• Auto Skip Animation — skips roll animations and disables Prismatic+ meteor cutscenes.
• Auto Collect Spin — purchases rolled ores matching your selected rarities.
• Rarity filtering lets you choose which ores to buy.
• Ore purchases check your available cash before buying.

AUTO UPGRADES
• Automatically purchase selected base upgrades, including regeneration, drills, luck, rolling pedestals, cages, floors, and furnace upgrades.
• Set a maximum purchase price to control spending.
• Separate furnace upgrade price cap.
• Auto Upgrade Minerals — upgrades equipped ores in unlocked tunnels.
• Configurable mineral upgrade price limit.
• Auto Equip Best — keeps your best ores equipped.

AUTO PETS
• Automatically buy lucky blocks for selected pet rarities using cash.
• Auto Open Pets — opens purchased lucky blocks and claims their random pets.
• Auto Place Pets — places pets on your current floor while you are inside your base.
• Skips additional pet slots requiring Robux.
• Optional pet purchase, opening, and placement notifications.

BOOSTS & REWARDS
• Auto Buy Boost — purchases selected equipment-shop items with cash.
• Auto Use Item — uses selected gems, coatings, time skips, furnace skips, and fragments.
• Auto Spin Wheel — uses available free spins.
• Automatically collect daily rewards, unlocked playtime rewards, and offline earnings.
• Redeem the script’s built-in code list in one click.
• Optional reward, item, and wheel notifications.

MOVEMENT & CUSTOMIZATION
• Fly with adjustable speed.
• Adjustable Walk Speed.
• Infinite Jump.
• Teleport to selected players or the nearest player.
• Move hotbar items into your inventory.
• Live profile, money, upgrade, and equipped-ore statistics.
• Save and load your settings.
• Customizable interface themes and window size.
